stem.text: What is a correct definition of the term transpiration?

A.text: diffusion of water from intercellular air spaces to the atmosphere where it evaporates

B.text: evaporation of water from the leaf surface of a plant via the stomata

C.text: loss of water vapour from the aerial parts of a plant to the atmosphere

D.text: movement of water from the xylem to the atmosphere through the cell walls only
